description: This file defines the Base64Attachment class, which is a validation rule for handling base64-encoded file attachments in an HRM system. It checks file type, extension, size, and filename length constraints.

classes.name: Base64Attachment
classes.description: A validation rule class that verifies properties of a base64-encoded file attachment, including type, extension, filename length, and size constraints.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializes allowed types, extensions, filename length constraints, size constraint, and strict size check flag.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the input array representing the attachment, checking presence of required fields, validity of type and extension, filename length constraints, and size matching.

methods.name: validateMin
methods.description: Checks if filename length is above the minimum threshold.

methods.name: validateMax
methods.description: Checks if filename length is below the maximum threshold.
